Best regards,
Team Roosterly

rows.reply_en:
Hi,

You can swap a shift by opening the shift in the app and tapping "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer swap). Colleagues with the same role can then accept the swap. The manager approves the request under Rooster → Verzoeken (Rota → Requests). Manager approval is enabled by default, but can be turned off via Instellingen → Rooster (Settings → Rota).

Best regards,
Team Roosterly

rows.reply_en:
Dear,

The Plus plan costs €6 per active employee per month (excluding VAT). For 25 active employees, this comes to €150 per month (excluding VAT).

You can upgrade at any time in the app under Instellingen → Abonnement (Settings → Subscription). The new price applies from the next invoice.

Best regards,
Team Roosterly
